name: litetms
description: Use your transport company's LiteTMS from your AI app, in plain language. You sign in with your own LiteTMS account, and the app works only with what your role allows.

interface.longDescription:
LiteTMS is a transport management system (TMS) that road carriers and freight forwarders use to run their fleet, drivers, contractors and transport orders. This plugin connects your company's LiteTMS workspace, so you can ask about your drivers and keep your reminders in plain language.

What you can do today:
- Find a driver or another employee by name, status or position, and see who is active.
- Get a person's phone numbers and e-mail addresses.
- Check their documents and expiry dates: valid, expiring, expired or unknown.
- See the vehicle and trailer a driver uses, their languages, ADR qualification and branches.
- List your own reminders, and add, move, change or delete one.
- Open any record in LiteTMS through a direct link.

How access works: you sign in with your own LiteTMS account. The plugin sees exactly what you may see in LiteTMS; your role and branches apply to every answer.

Who it is for: dispatchers, forwarders, fleet managers and office staff of companies that already use LiteTMS.

Limits: it changes data only through the tools made for that, never beyond your role, and your company's audit log records each change; everything else is read only. A reminder stays yours unless you ask for the whole company to see it. Orders, vehicles and GPS positions are not available yet. It never returns home addresses, dates of birth, bank details, salary, document numbers or attached files.

Before you start: you need a LiteTMS account, and AI app access has to be turned on for your company. An administrator turns it on in LiteTMS under Administration > Marketplace, or with one click on the Allow page the first time they connect. Then enter your company's LiteTMS address (for example acme for acme.litetms.eu), sign in and choose Allow. Disconnect at any time in LiteTMS under Settings > Connected apps.
